changes: Derived full/light/minimal runtimes and extensions; long is replaced by vlong.
Restore temporary reader bounds on decode and packed-read failures.
Validate explicit decode/skip lengths and bound skipped varints to ten bytes.
Correct unknown group skipping for empty message types.
Protect the shared LongBits zero value against mutation.

implementation.basis: The full/light/minimal protobuf runtimes are derived from upstream, with focused bounds and unknown-field corrections. Generated protocol schemas are a separate retained input, not an independent-runtime claim.
implementation.targetScope: The protobuf reader/writer and message encoding/decoding paths used by Firestore, gax and Firebase event schemas.
implementation.remainingWork: Independently implement the application-facing runtime paths; retain current conformance and correctness fixes as requirements.
